evals.prompt: Refactor a SageMaker Pipeline that hardcodes S3 paths, runs raw Python functions without `@step`, and registers every model unconditionally as `Approved` even when `f1_score` drops to `0.42`. Show the production SDK v3 `@step` DAG with parameters, caching, Warm Pools, `ConditionStep`, `FailStep`, and `PendingManualApproval`.
evals.expected_output: Applies all 5 pipeline standards: (1) `ParameterString`, `ParameterFloat` (`f1_threshold`), `ParameterInteger` (zero hardcoded URIs/thresholds); (2) `@step` (`sagemaker.workflow.function_step.step`) decorating `preprocess`, `train` (`use_spot_instances=True`, `keep_alive_period_in_seconds=600`, `MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`), `evaluate`, and `register_model`; (3) `CacheConfig(enable_caching=True, expire_after="P30D")`; (4) `ConditionStep` (`ConditionGreaterThanOrEqualTo` on `f1_score >= f1_threshold`) routing `if_steps` to `register_model` with **`ModelApprovalStatus="PendingManualApproval"`** + `ModelMetrics` and `else_steps` to **`FailStep`**.
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-mlops-pipelines skill

Parameterizes S3 URIs and metric thresholds (`ParameterString`, `ParameterFloat`, `ParameterInteger`), applies `@step` + `CacheConfig(enable_caching=True, expire_after="P30D")` + Warm Pool `keep_alive_period_in_seconds`
Enforces `ConditionStep` (`ConditionGreaterThanOrEqualTo`) routing passing runs to `PendingManualApproval` in `ModelPackageGroup` and failing runs to `FailStep`

evals.prompt: Design a SageMaker Feature Store (`CfnFeatureGroup`) serving two consumers: (1) a sub-millisecond `50,000 QPS` real-time ad-bidding endpoint, and (2) historical model training that kept leaking future feature values into training rows when using plain S3 CSV joins. evals.expected_output: Compares all 3 Feature Store tiers: Online `Standard` (DynamoDB-backed single-digit ms `GetRecord`/`BatchGetRecord` + KMS + `TtlDuration`), Online **`InMemory`** (ElastiCache-backed **sub-millisecond** ultra-high-QPS tier for the 50k QPS bidder, bounding memory cost via `TtlDuration`), and Offline **`TableFormat: "Iceberg"`** (S3 + Glue Data Catalog ACID tables with Athena time-travel and **`EventTimeFeatureName` point-in-time accurate joins** eliminating future-data leakage).
expectations: Activates the sagemaker-mlops-pipelines skill
Distinguishes Online `Standard` (DynamoDB single-digit ms) from Online **`InMemory`** (ElastiCache sub-ms ultra-high QPS with `TtlDuration` cost bounds)
Prescribes Offline Store **`TableFormat: "Iceberg"`** using `EventTimeFeatureName` point-in-time accurate joins to eliminate training data leakage
